title: SpendLimit

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Limit amount as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of `currency` (cents for USD): "50000" is $500.00. `null` means no numeric cap is configured at this scope — see the effective report for whether a limit applies.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime at which the spend limit was created.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency; the unit for `amount`.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique tagged ID of the spend limit (`spl_...`).

is_enabled.title: Is Enabled
is_enabled.description: Read-only. `false` when extra usage is switched off for this organization (`organization` limit); `amount` is kept and applies again when it's switched back on. Always `true` for other limits.

period.description: Length of the window the limit resets over. `amount` caps spend within each period.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: What the limit applies to. A tagged union on `type`; each variant carries the identifier for its scope.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime at which the spend limit was last modified.

description: A configured spend limit: a cap on metered spend for one scope and period.
